entries.title: Primary platform: bedrock
entries.content: Detected bedrock (90%: bedrock/BP/manifest.json, bedrock/RP/manifest.json). Minecraft version: 1.21.

entries.title: Default namespace "studiocreatures"
entries.content: New resource locations, sound events and item models use this namespace unless the user says otherwise.

entries.title: Creatures as a Bedrock add-on + Blockbench projects
entries.content: Custom entities need a client mod/model engine on Java; Bedrock supports them natively. Each creature ships as Bedrock geometry/animations/client+behavior entity, plus a .bbmodel for Blockbench/ModelEngine users.
